avis.titre: My holy grail hyaluronic acid serum!
avis.texte: I've been using Sunday Riley's Tidal serum for about 6 weeks now, and it's become a staple in my skincare routine — especially when my skin feels dry, tight, or dull. This isn't just your average HA serum — it has five types of hyaluronic acid, which really helps to hydrate different layers of my skin.The polyglutamic acid (yes, that's a thing) is very effective at locking in moisture — I've noticed my skin stays bouncy throughout the day. It feels like a lightweight water-gel that forms a "breathable water seal" on your skin, giving you that juicy, dewy finish without greasiness. Instead of snail mucin, this uses a plant-derived alternative — great if you want that bounce but prefer cruelty-free ingredients. I use it both morning and night. It layers nicely under moisturizer or sunscreen without pilling.It's vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free, which is a big plus for me. If your skin feels parched, tight, or lacks bounce, this serum is absolutely worth trying. It's one of those hydration powerhouses that doesn't feel heavy or sticky, but leaves you looking dewy and plumped. For the price, I don't use it like a "treatment" product — more like a daily hydration boost — and in that role, it's been fantastic.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was my first time using anything from this brand, and it definitely exceeded my expectations. The packing is nice and serum is good consistency. It has sort of like a chemical smell to it but I don't notice it anymore. I'm usually very sensitive to new products, but this serum didn't irritate my skin at all. It hydrated my skin really well and left it feeling soft and healthy. Overall, I'm really happy with it and would definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: A tiny drop restored my moisture and improved elasticity.
avis.texte: During these colder months when my skin usually feels dry and dehydrated, this hydrating serum has truly brought the moisture back. My skin looks refreshed and glowy again! I also never knew that as I got older and started noticing some loose skin, a serum could actually help restore the elasticity in my face and neck, but this one really has. You only need a tiny amount because it goes a long way, and my face feels so soft and smooth after applying it. Highly recommend for anyone needing a boost of hydration and firmness this season! avis.titre: Wanted to Love but Not for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wanted to love this product because instantly when I put it on it was light, hydrating, and glided on like a breeze. I loved how refreshed I looked really gave that glaze doughnut look which was perfect for the night routine. Unfortunately I didn't even last five minutes before I had to wash it off. My skin is usually sensitive to touch (just some redness that goes away after a bit) but I haven't had a problem with any products in until this point. I was feeling an itchy burning sensation so I didn't even get to the picture. I didn't use any other products with this so I knew it wasn't a mixture problem. Not sure what exactly happened, I didn't use any let my face calm down and took it easy for a week before doing a spot test on my cheek and same thing happened so I gave up. If you do not have sensitive I definitely recommend as it is super hydrating. If you have sensitive skin I would be caution. I did picture my face after it calmed down a bit after washing it has little bumps that formed under the skin making me think that I may have had a reaction to something I'm just unsure of what. I also pictured the ingredients for anyone who is curious.

avis.titre: Sunday Riley TIDAL Deep Hydration + Plumping Serum
avis.texte: I grabbed this serum because the name promised "deep hydration + plumping," and after using it for a few weeks, I'm genuinely impressed. The texture is lightweight yet visibly rich—it glides on smoothly and absorbs pretty quickly without leaving that tight or sticky feeling. My skin has felt noticeably more supple and hydrated, especially in the morning when I wake up and it still looks "filled in" rather than flat. I love that the formula includes multiple forms of hyaluronic acid and lotus‑root mucin to lock in moisture and help with that plump‑look. (According to the brand it's wrapped in a "breathable water seal" to keep the moisture sealed in). ￼ One thing to note: while the hydration is impressive, I didn't see dramatic changes in texture overnight—so it's not a miracle fix, but definitely a strong "make my skin feel good" serum. On the flip side, the scent is mild but noticeable (some reviewers mention they don't love it) so if you're super fragrance‑sensitive you might want to patch‑test. ￼ All in all, if you're looking to upgrade your hydration game and give your skin a plumper, healthier look without heavy formulas, this one's a solid choice in my routine.

I could see the hydration results almost immediately which is what this serum's main focus is. For that, this is a win. I got this free in exchange for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Sunday Riley Tidal Deep Hydration + Plumping Serum for a little while now, and I have a few thoughts to share. When I first started using it, the smell definitely caught my attention. It's not awful, but it has a bit of a strange scent that I wasn't expecting. It fades after a little while, but it's noticeable at first. The texture is also a little sticky when you apply it, so it takes a minute or two to fully sink into the skin. As for the plumping claim, I honestly haven't noticed much of a difference yet. My skin doesn't look significantly fuller or bouncier, at least not so far. However, what I do love about this serum is how soft and hydrated it makes my skin feel. Every time I use it, my face feels instantly smoother and refreshed. The real difference is noticeable the next morning it makes my skin always feel so moisturized and healthy when I wake up. Even though I'm not completely sold on the plumping aspect, I still really enjoy how nourishing it is. It's great for keeping my skin soft and hydrated, especially during the colder months. I'll keep using it to see if the long-term results improve, but for now, I'd say it's worth trying if you're mainly looking for a serum that gives lasting hydration and leaves your skin feeling super soft.
